The water is clear, and the background of the tank is dark. (3) The camera returns to a medium group shot. The characters are engaged in animated conversation, gesturing with their hands toward the fish tanks. High-density yellow and white variety-style text overlays frequently pop in and out at the bottom of the frame. (4) A shiba inu meme graphic in a circular frame overlays the screen near one of the hosts, accompanied by red warning icons and text. The man on the right wears a tan shirt and a black beanie, looking on as the others joke. (5) The group continues interacting, with frequent camera angle shifts between the speakers and close-ups of the fish. The environment includes greenery and fish breeding equipment in the soft-focus background.
